==Overview==
* Constructs a [[great work]] in Sandling, Weirwater.
* Passed
* More information can be found in the '''[[An_eagle_in_song|An eagle in song]]''' wind of fortune

* 30 wains of white granite
* 90 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Ozren_Orzel_Inspirational_Tomb}}
==Outcome==
Once complete, the inspiration of Orzen Orzel will have the following effects:
* [[congregation|Congregations]] in [[Weirwater]] will receive a [[Philtre of Strength]] each season
* The eighty-one individuals named by '''Tarik''', former [[High Bard of the Empire]], will receive some form of reward from the Witches of Culwich
